goals: Use idle local GPU time to find a better one-view CIFAR-10 model under 2 M parameters than the flip-equivariant airbench finalists
now: 24-hour eqaug study running on the 5070 Ti (job 4457, started 2026-11-11 ~21:25, up to 400 trials, rung pruning, two seeds a trial, starting from FIN and T39). The scoreboard (val_1view) updates as bests arrive.
next: At the end: read the study, retrain any best above 95.57 % (FIN 95.27 + 0.3 tolerance) over 5 seeds at 40 and 100 epochs before it counts
